headline: Accepted a painting donated by Norma von Frick and will ask the City Manager for updates on building projects.
summary: Donna Richards announced she will step down as chair after seven years but stay on the board. Trustees also heard reports from the library director and the Friends group, and they moved old business to the next meeting.
decisions: Accepted the September 9, 2026 meeting minutes unanimously.
Accepted a donated painting from Norma von Frick, unanimously.
Decided to ask the City Manager for updates on building projects and suggest a meeting of relevant parties.
Continued discussion of old business to the next meeting.

decision_evidence.quote: The meeting minutes from September 9, 2026 were unanimously accepted on a motion by Courtney McSparron and seconded by Jack Moynihan.
Motion to accept the painting was made by Judy Davidson, seconded by Courtney McSparron. The trustees voted unanimously to accept the painting.

Trustees expressed concern about the lack of progress on several building projects that have been submitted. The decision was made to reach out to the City Manager for relevant updates and suggest a meeting of relevant parties.
Discussion of old business was forwarded to the next meeting.

plain_text:
Pollard Memorial Board of Trustees  – Meeting Minutes
Date:
o The meeting took place on Wednesday, October 14, 2026.
Location: 
o The meeting was held at Pollard Memorial Library (PML), 401 Merrimack St. Lowell, MA, as a 
hybrid meeting, both in person and via Zoom.
Opening Business
Meeting Call to Order
o The meeting was called to order by Donna Richards at 5:35 pm.
Attendance
Present: Excused: Guests:
Bridget Cooley, Library Director
     Donna Richards, Chair
     Ellen Anstey, Vice Chair
     Judith Davidson, Secretary
     Suzanne Frechette
     Helen Littlefield
     Courtney McSparron
     Jack Moynihan
     Christopher St. Croix - ZOOM
Jaylynne Ogbeide
Christine O’Connor
     Lisa Golden, Director HHS
Adoption of / Amendment to Agenda
o The agenda for October 14th was unanimously approved on a motion by Donna Richards, 
seconded by Helen Littlefield.
Prior Meeting Minutes Approval
o The meeting minutes from September 9, 2026 were unanimously accepted on a motion by 
Courtney McSparron and seconded by Jack Moynihan.
Public Comment Period
o Public comment time was made available.  However, no members of the public were present 
to make a comment at this meeting.
2
Current Business
Donation of Artwork
o Director Cooley notified the board that Norma von Frick donated a painting.  
o Motion to accept the painting was made by Judy Davidson, seconded by Courtney McSparron. 
The trustees voted unanimously to accept the painting.  Director Cooley will decide where to 
place it within the library.
AI Meeting Notes
Richards reported.
o At the September meeting the board made a motion to request an opinion from the Law 
Department as to whether the Trustees could use AI to document meetings and prepare 
formal meeting minutes.  A letter making this request was mailed to City Solicitor Corey 
Williams.  Richards verified the letter was received.  No determination has yet been made by 
the City Solicitor.
MMA Legislative Breakfast – October 30th - Lowell, MA
Richards announced.
o Each year, the MMA (Massachusetts Mutual Association) hosts meetings across the 
Commonwealth to give local leaders, legislators and MMA staff the opportunity to network in 
an informal setting and learn about and discuss issues of importance at the local and state 
level.
o The MMA’s Legislative Division staff will discuss the latest activity in Legislature, which has 
wide-ranging implications for cities and towns. Topics will include the FY27 state budget, FY26 
“Fair Share” supplemental budget, transportation bond bill, PROTECT Act, and ongoing 
developments regarding economic development, energy affordability, and environmental 
legislation, and much more!
3
o Lowell – 10/30/26 - 8:30am with a light breakfast and coffee, followed by presentations and 
Q&A which will end by 10:15am Mayor’s Reception Room, Lowell City Hall.  Meetings are free 
to attend. REGISTRATION IS REQUIRED, visit www.mma.org or contact Abigail Ferrone at 617-
426-7272, ext. 130, or aferrone@mma.org.
Donation for the PML approved by City Council
o Acceptance of a donation of $1,000.00 from the Demoulas Foundation, made to the City of 
Lowell for the PML, was approved by the City Council on October 6, 2026. 
Review of PML Board of Trustees Bylaws
o The Documents were sent to Chris O’Connor for her review.
Update from Strategic Plan Task Groups
o There were no updates to report.
Reports
Chairperson’s Report
o Richards, announced that after seven years as Chair of the PML Board of Trustees she plans to
step down from this office, but she will continue as a member of the Board of Trustees.  She 
welcomes questions and plans to give full support to whomever takes on the position. 
Trustees who are interested in serving as Chair, or who would like additional information 
about the role, can contact her.
There was discussion of the announcement, including when the vote would take place.  New 
officers must be nominated in December and voted on at the first meeting in January.  
Trustees spoke of their regard for Richards’ work over the years and the many roles and 
improvements she has made.  A question about co-chair possibilities was raised, and do the 
by-laws accommodate this.  It was suggested we check with Chris O’Connor for her 
interpretation of this issue and the by-laws.  Richards will send out a list of the tasks/duties of
4
the Chair’s position (Exp: 10 agendas; organization of the meetings; signing the State-Aid 
forms for Director).
o Richards created a table of the current member terms that was handed out.  Trustees 
discussed how to stagger the terms, so the positions are distributed over time.  Richards 
provided a model in which: 3 positions in 2026; 3 in 2027; and 4 in 2028 will expire.   This table
should be added in the new bylaws to ensure we comply with “completing the remainder of a 
term.”.  The date of a term ending must be sent to HR with the request to fill a position.  
Bridget will correct Jaylynne on the City of Lowell website.
o Trustees also discussed the procedure for renewing or declining your position as a trustee.  
For current terms expiring 12/31/26 Director Cooley would like notification by the November 
Trustees Meeting requesting renewal or resignation, ccd to Chair Richards.  The requests will 
be sent together as a bundle.
o Jack Moynihan and Judy Davidson urged members of the Trustees to attend the upcoming 
Open House at O'Leary Library - UMASS Lowell – Tuesday, October 20th from 4:00-6:00pm.
Committee Reports
o The Committees as defined in the current version of the Trustee Bylaws will meet on an as 
needed basis.  
o NO Committee meetings were held.
Director’s Report
o Bridget Cooley prepared the Director’s Report dated October 8, 2026 which was distributed to
trustees via email prior to the meeting.  Specific discussion arose around numerous issues 
including:
 Preparing for the Friends of the Library Book Drop on the upcoming Saturday.
 Received books from UML for 9/11/26 service day.
 Working on new library integrated system.
 City and Mosaic Lowell—invited library to LTC meeting-crossing community groups.
 Bi-Centennial Event at Library—still receiving positive comments.   It received good 
coverage.  Technology worked and library staff utilized as many tools as possible.
 Director Cooley heard that the Abisi Adult Education Center needs more classroom 
space.   The interim director of Adult Education and Cooley are collaborating to 
accommodate students in the library 5 days a week.
 Programs offered are well attended .
 Trustees expressed concern about the lack of progress on several building projects 
that have been submitted.  The decision was made to reach out to the City Manager 
for relevant updates and suggest a meeting of relevant parties.  Chair Richards will 
initiate this process. 
Grants
o There were no grants to report on.
5
PML Foundation (Donna Richards)
o Donna Richards provided the following PML Foundation Report.
 The PMLF met on Wednesday, September 16, 2026.
 The recipients of the Lipman Award will be recognized in November.  Elinor Lipman will be 
present to acknowledge the winner and this year, an honorable mention award.
Thursday, November 19, at 6:00 pm.  
 The Outreach Committee is preparing the Fall Appeal campaign.
 The Foundation members approved the purchase of an audio system to improve sound 
quality at large events, a Balloon Twisting 101 class 10/23/from 3-5pm, and the purchase 
of newly released books for the Lowell Book Corner in Reference Room.
 The next regular PMLF meeting is scheduled for October 18, 2026 at 8:30am.
Friends of the PML (Helen Littlefield)
o Helen Littlefield provided the following Friends Liaison Report.
 Friends of the Library Fall Book Sale is happening November 14, 2026, Saturday, 9 A.M.-3 
P.M.
 Donations of Books, Movie DVDs, music CDs welcome before the sale: Book drop date: 
Saturday, October 17, 2026, 9 A.M.-12 P.M. in the Community Room.
 The Friends are looking for help with collecting, sorting and boxing up the donated items.
o Book Donation Day: Saturday, Oct. 17, 9am-noon.  Volunteers are needed to 
unpack and sort the donations into media type and genre categories.
o Sale Set-Up Day: Friday, Nov. 13, 9:30am until finished.  This requires putting up 
signage, setting up tables and putting out all DVDs, audiobooks, and books. Books 
are sorted by topic and type.  
o Sale Day: Saturday, Nov. 14, 9am-3pm.  Assist buyers, restock tables.
o Sale Day Break-Down, Nov. 14, 2-5pm.  Box up remaining books, take down tables 
and signage. 
 Please contact: friendsofpml@lowelllibrary.org
 The Friends’ next meeting is Dec 5, 9:15 am in Library Director’s office.
Old Business
o Discussion of old business was forwarded to the next meeting.  These issues included:
 An advocacy meeting with key Lowell legislators and developing an advocacy agenda for 
the library.
 Review of materials to onboard new members. 
New Business (Announcements and Questions )
o MBLC will discontinue our current Trustee’s email at the end of August 2027.  Director Cooley 
suggests moving to a google based system all around.
o The library has received a reconsideration request from a patron.  Cooley will assist the patron
to make a purchase request instead.
6
Adjournment
o The meeting was adjourned at 7:07 pm on a motion by Donna Richards and seconded by 
Helen Littlefield.   All in attendance were in favor.
o NOTE - Our next meeting is November 4, 2026.
